PRAN-RFL Group, one of the most diversified and innovation-driven conglomerates in Bangladesh, is seeking talented and dynamic professionals for the position of Management Trainee Officer – Brand. With a strong legacy of excellence, we continue to lead in delivering quality, value, and innovation across a wide range of industries.
This role offers aspiring professionals the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand management, marketing strategy, and consumer engagement. The selected candidate will work closely with senior brand managers and cross-functional teams to learn, contribute, and grow into a future leader in the marketing function.
Job Responsibilities:
Support the formulation and implementation of ATL (Above-the-Line), BTL (Below-the-Line), and TTL (Through-the-Line) marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility, strengthen market presence, and improve consumer engagement.
Contribute to the planning, development, and execution of integrated brand campaigns aligned with organizational objectives, market trends, and consumer insights.
Collaborate with creative agencies, media partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely, effective, and high-quality execution of brand initiatives.
Conduct deep-dive research to track industry trends, analyze consumer behavior, and benchmark competitors, providing insights that guide strategic decision-making.
Deliver actionable insights to support product positioning, promotional planning, and market entry strategies, ensuring alignment with business goals.
Assist in tracking, analyzing, and reporting brand performance metrics, preparing regular dashboards and reports for senior management.
Contribute to developing and executing brand differentiation strategies to build and sustain strong brand equity.
Assist in product innovation activities, including packaging development, pricing strategies, and promotional planning to maintain market competitiveness.

Market standard salary (Review after 6 months probation period based on performance)
